name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 3 – Am 110
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 3a. Deplores the far right’s strategy of stoking fear and dividing society in pursuit of electoral gains; strongly condemns the far right’s actions and statements that contribute to discrimination against and the stigmatisation of Muslim citizens or those it labels as such; warns of the damaging consequences of this strategy for these citizens, society as a whole and democracy;
